consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: earth leakage and protection setting integrity

facts.title: stored energy found after isolation of TX-8001

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the earth leakage and protection setting integrity on TX-8001 and G-8102 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically inspecting and maintaining portable equipment. TX-8001 (station switchgear) is in service for station HV distribution. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was in place but did not perform. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 17 July 2011 a hazard report was recorded on TX-8001 and G-8102 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during an intrusive maintenance task; electrical energy held as HV switchgear was not released.
